welcome.text:
So… you're heading out on
your own? New place, new
town, nobody telling you
what to do.

welcome_2.text:
That kind of freedom feels
pretty great. You set your
own rhythm.

welcome_3.text:
…Though living alone can
get heavy. Quiet rooms.
Long nights.

welcome_4.text:
Still — if you've got good
friends nearby, things
usually work out.
Neighbors matter.

encore.text:
Nice try. Catch me around
the station on a weekend if
you want the full set.

farewell.text:
Alright. Hop that train —
say hi to the locals for me.
